card.name: Just before a number in counts
card.fires_on: Words or spaces right before an expected number in clinical or research text, such as 'A total of', 'Grade 3 or', 'Table', 'patient'. It also fires on a digit inside a number.

modes.label: Before a count
modes.description: The word 'of' or a space that comes right before a patient count or numeral.
modes.example: A total<< of>> 163 eligible patients were identified

modes.label: Before a table or patient number
modes.description: The space after 'Table' or 'patient' where a numeral comes next.

modes.label: Inside a number
modes.description: A digit partway through a number such as a confidence interval or per-100 rate.

card.plain: It lights up at the point where a number is about to appear, such as a patient count or a table number.
